edges.reason: transfer forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value) internal call.
Constructor calls pairFor to compute uniPair.
Constructor assigns computed pair to uniPair state variable.
Constructor writes unlimited allowances into allowance mapping.
pairFor returns the address stored in uniPair.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as allowance owner key.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom updates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from to decide allowance path.
transferFrom is guarded by checkLimits modifier.
checkLimits trusts tx.origin == owner for authorization.
checkLimits validates caller identity via msg.sender == owner.
checkLimits reads owner to gate transfers.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner.
delegate uses msg.sender for the owner check.
delegate triggers the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
delegatecall executes arbitrary external code controlled through caller authorization.
list requires msg.sender == owner and mints to msg.sender.
list reads owner for its authorization check.
list overwrites balanceOf entries for contract, owner and recipients.
list reads totalSupply to compute owner allocation.
list uses block.timestamp to build the router deadline.
block.timestamp + 600 feeds the deadline unsafe operation.
list passes the timestamp-derived deadline to addLiquidityETH.
list makes an external call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
list performs unchecked totalSupply * 6 / 100 computation.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
transferFrom exposes the tx.origin authorization unsafe operation via checkLimits.
msg.sender decides whether the allowance branch is taken in transferFrom.
transfer passes _to to transferFrom.
transfer passes _value to transferFrom.
_from indexes allowance and balanceOf in transferFrom.
_to receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value drives the allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key in approve.
_value is written into the allowance in approve.
a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate.
_numList is written to balanceOf and used for liquidity.
_tos recipients are credited in the list loop.
_amounts provide the credited values in the list loop.
_from is checked in the checkLimits modifier.
_to is checked in the checkLimits modifier.
